component.name: Gossip
component.summary: Explore and manage secrets in the cloud, Vault and Kubernetes

description.p: Gossip is a desktop application to browse, read, create and version secrets in Google Cloud Secret Manager, AWS Secrets Manager and Parameter Store, Azure Key Vault, Ansible Vault, HashiCorp Vault / OpenBao and Kubernetes, from one native GTK 4 interface.

ul.li: Values stay hidden until you reveal them, are wiped from the clipboard after 30 seconds and are forgotten when the screen locks.
Version history with compare, restore, enable / disable and destroy where the provider allows it.
Read-only mode, an optional local audit trail and import / export between environments.
English and Spanish interface, light and dark themes.
